reply.summary: Racin is a blue-eyed chimpanzee sleuth who trusts only facts and a good magnifying glass. Racin was an ordinary person until a primate-turning scheme changed his shape.

feats.scene: Racin hops onto a desk and clubs a pickpocket with a rolled newspaper.
Racin tumbles off a fence and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Lastu is a talking chimpanzee sleuth who becomes the new mortal host of a rhyming fiend. Lastu carries a night-black blade and follows a sorceress against a vengeful wizard.

feats.scene: Lastu swings the night blade and cleaves a stone gargoyle in two.
Lastu is hurled through a cloister arch by a spell and rises, scowling.

reply.summary: Neslenia is a once-abused circus chimpanzee who sipped from an ageless spring and gained a brilliant mind. Neslenia inherits a legendary blade and guards a far-off realm.

feats.scene: Neslenia slashes a ghoul army's gate and splits the timbers.
Neslenia is swatted by a swamp horror and clambers back up, hat askew.

reply.summary: Vicinnte is a clever chimpanzee investigator who mixes acrobatics with a monkey-style kung fu. Vicinnte often aids a cowled crimefighter on cases involving other animals.

feats.scene: Vicinnte somersaults off a banister and kicks a smuggler through a door.
Vicinnte slams onto a crate and bounces up grinning.

reply.summary: Orasti is a green-skinned alien who dons an owl guise and joins a gang of enemies of flying aces. Orasti shows up for just one fight and is soon beaten.

feats.scene: Orasti swoops down with talons and rips the canopy from a small plane.
Orasti is knocked off a wing and lands in the grass, ruffled.

reply.summary: Tisiava is a bald occultist and mob enforcer from the islands who has raised the recently departed to serve. Tisiava stays loyal to a crime family until the son tries to betray the clan.

feats.scene: Tisiava chants over a fresh grave and a stiff corpse claws up to attack.
Tisiava takes a cudgel blow while finishing his chant and does not stop.

reply.summary: Tanan is a mind-hopping virus engineered in a corporate lab that steers captured bodies like puppets. Tanan escapes a raided warehouse and dies of radiation inside an immune host.

feats.scene: Tanan drives a stolen body through a chain-link fence and into a patrol car.
Tanan is exposed to hard radiation inside a borrowed shell and perishes.

reply.summary: Taeol is a reserve recruit from a squat-bodied race whose only gift is a nearly impenetrable hide. Taeol was judged too passive for active duty yet shows remarkable resilience.

feats.scene: Taeol rolls into a training dummy and tips it over.
Taeol curls up as a collapsing training hall falls on him and emerges untouched.

reply.summary: Aultumreo is a blond speedster raised by a state program as one of three orphans and sent to chase a famed runner. Aultumreo is stern, loyal to his homeland, and fast enough to leave afterimages.

feats.scene: Aultumreo races across a frozen field and scorches the snow at his heels.
Aultumreo hits a sentry at full tilt and shatters a gate post.
Aultumreo tumbles at speed across ice and stands up unhurt.

reply.summary: Llitel is a masked enforcer and acrobat who dresses like a festival skeleton and speaks two languages. Llitel survived being pierced by a glowing armored hand and limped home to report.

feats.scene: Llitel flips off a crate and lands a spinning kick that floors a bouncer.
Llitel is run through by a bright armored fist and still stumbles away alive.

reply.summary: Tacil is a blond woman of a hidden group of gifted outcasts who can compel honest answers by magic. Tacil is a mother who flares with rage when her daughter is endangered.

feats.scene: Tacil overloads a room with sudden emotion and sends a roomful of armed men reeling.
Tacil has her arm snapped in a scuffle and keeps standing.

reply.summary: Rauor is a black-haired time-hopping traveler who rides a round vessel through the ages. Rauor works for a vigilant order that guards the timeline.

feats.scene: Rauor kicks open the hatch of a round craft and drops onto a platform.
Rauor is jolted by a rough landing and brushes off the dust.

reply.summary: Tonnima is a retired blond archer who once fought crime and still pushes her daughter toward the family trade. Tonnima's pride in the old days weighs on her family.

feats.scene: Tonnima looses an old arrow from her attic wall bow into a target's heart.
Tonnima falls off a ladder and grabs a rafter in time.

reply.summary: Iumam is a blond hired killer enhanced with crystalline implants, working in tandem with a former comrade. Iumam is quick, strong, and heals from wounds that would sideline others.

feats.scene: Iumam flings a van door across a lot and pins an escaping target.
Iumam takes a point-blank burst and closes the holes within minutes.

reply.summary: Sesti is a purple-haired, grey-skinned peacekeeper from a far-off star system who wields a will-fueled band. Sesti helps a bumbling stand-in thwart a villain's vortex device.

feats.scene: Sesti conjures a glowing hammer and flattens a drone fleet.
Sesti raises a glowing barrier that holds against falling debris from a collapsing station.

reply.summary: Nanlli is a pink-skinned, white-haired peacekeeper who befriends a newcomer while secretly serving a rogue's plot. Nanlli wields a will-driven band and falls in the climactic fight.

feats.scene: Nanlli sculpts a glowing lance and punches it through a hull plate.
Nanlli's shield flares and absorbs a barrage from a cruiser's guns.

reply.summary: Miiuria is a dark-haired criminal whose roar can stun even a nearly unbreakable hero and whose stomps shake a block. Miiuria is notably tougher than ordinary people.

feats.scene: Miiuria punches the pavement and sends a rolling quake down the avenue.
Miiuria stands unflinching as a delivery van clips him.

reply.summary: Annont is a black-haired riverboat pilot who guides parties upriver through dangerous jungle. Annont and his partner overpower a gang of kidnappers and bring a hostage home.

feats.scene: Annont clubs a rifleman with a boat oar and takes his weapon.
Annont tumbles off the deck into muddy water and swims back.

reply.summary: Irnsorolu is a blond assassin who learned many fighting styles in the harbors of the east and nurses an old grudge against a boyhood friend. Irnsorolu prefers throwing stars and reinforced batons with hooked blades.

feats.scene: Irnsorolu whips a hooked baton through a rope bridge and drops it.
Irnsorolu takes a thrown kick to the chest and spins away upright.

reply.summary: Sitausu is a bald, upbeat time traveler who idolizes famous adventurers and guards a fixed moment of history. Sitausu kills anyone who tries to alter that moment, until his idols show him another way.

feats.scene: Sitausu throws a rival traveler against a trench wall and silences him.
Sitausu is bowled over by a shell blast and gets up with a shrug.

reply.summary: Corlortes is a rich idler who has an explorer murdered to hush her complaint about ocean creatures. Corlortes is later confronted by that explorer, returned for justice, and pays heavily.

feats.scene: Corlortes slaps a ledger off a desk and orders a goon to act.
Corlortes is dragged into a tide pool by sea creatures and gasps for air.

reply.summary: Amoson is a thug whose face carries the permanent imprint of a boot from a past beating. Amoson works for a shadowy syndicate and dies in one of its schemes.

feats.scene: Amoson drives a shoulder through a flimsy door and tackles a clerk.
Amoson takes a stomp to the face and shows the dent for years afterward.

reply.summary: Lutes is a black-haired scientist from a city shrunk in a bottle, who slips out and poses as a hero. Lutes proposes marriage to a woman who refuses to move into his tiny home.

feats.scene: Lutes bats a toppled girder off a pedestrian in the guise of a rescuer.
Lutes is knocked into a row of stalls and keeps up the act.

reply.summary: Liceoiu is an ancient finned predator from a world long dead, now drafted into a fear-fueled army. Liceoiu holds a captive by the arms while a tyrant works on his mind.

feats.scene: Liceoiu pins a thrashing captive with enormous forelimbs until a yellow glow flares.
Liceoiu is hit by a volley of rubble and shrugs, scales rattling.

reply.summary: Eslis is a black-haired flier from a cold land famed for feats of raw strength and for mangling the local tongue. Eslis once escaped enemy territory in a dress with a squad of friends.

feats.scene: Eslis lifts a barrel of fuel and heaves it onto a plane wing.
Eslis walks away from a rough crash landing in a field.

reply.summary: Ileonva is a blond, blue-eyed state-trained brawler who swings a heavy tool and boasts of equal treatment in a fight. Ileonva fights alongside a sibling and a gang of troublemakers.

feats.scene: Ileonva smashes a mallet into a steel beam and kinks it.
Ileonva shrugs off a car door slammed across his back.

reply.summary: Arrermil is a stylish member of a research collective who patrols a bright capital after dark. Arrermil is a showman with a flair for rescues and quiet sincerity.

feats.scene: Arrermil vaults a railing and delivers a flying kick to a purse-snatcher.
Arrermil skids across a rooftop and hops up smiling.

reply.summary: Nitorore is a bald henchman who serves a bird-themed gangster as pilot and informant. Nitorore tracks a famous reporter's hideout and spirits his employer out of danger.

feats.scene: Nitorore throws a heavy case onto a pursuer from a rooftop.
Nitorore ducks a flying chair and keeps the helicopter steady.

reply.summary: Iusile is a wandering spirit of a murdered trapeze artist who slips into bodies, turns unseen, and drifts through the air. Iusile cannot linger in one host for long.

feats.scene: Iusile possesses a bruiser and drives his fist through a wall.
Iusile passes through a barrage of bullets without feeling a thing.

reply.summary: Resasnu is a skeletal wraith in a rotted acrobat costume who serves a higher power and sits quietly in a smoky club. Resasnu chats with a mortal about the afterlife.

feats.scene: Resasnu seizes a hothead's body and walks him out of a brawl.
Resasnu stands in a hail of gunfire without any harm.

reply.summary: Sturnili is a bald, grey-eyed wraith who floats beside two stranger companions when they visit a boy on a night of the dead. Sturnili is a quiet, gentle presence in the room.

feats.scene: Sturnili rattles a window latch to get a boy's attention.
Sturnili drifts through a crashing door unharmed.

reply.summary: Siunin is a bodiless wraith in a white mask and red tights who possesses creatures, turns unseen, and strolls through walls. Siunin can fly between the lands of the living and the lands beyond.

feats.scene: Siunin leaps into a guard dog and pulls a fence off its posts.
Siunin passes through a locked vault door as if it were fog.

reply.summary: Ceriare is a bald wraith of a circus star shot mid-performance who wanders in sorrow seeking his killer. Ceriare helps a living hero fight a spectral army in a graveyard.

feats.scene: Ceriare slips into a hostile host and shoves a spectral rider off its mount.
Ceriare is hit by a ghostly lance and floats on, unscathed.

reply.summary: Eonnt is a red-haired metallurgist who invents a springy alloy and stitches it into a suit that lets him ricochet endlessly. Eonnt is brought down once his rival finds a way to dull the bounce.

feats.scene: Eonnt ricochets off three walls and slams a guard into the ceiling.
Eonnt bounces off a speeding truck and lands in a crouch.

reply.summary: Minise is a brown-eyed hunter of gifted fugitives who rides a flying bike and wears a power-sapping harness. Minise takes a fat fee to trap a powerful young hero and fails.

feats.scene: Minise swings an energy knife through a steel locker door.
Minise has a wrist snapped by his target and flies off, wincing.

reply.summary: Sonnu is a costumed crusader who targets crooks, assisted by a floating computerized helper. Sonnu is later found to be a laboratory duplicate made from stolen cell scraps.

feats.scene: Sonnu cracks a mobster's jaw in a back alley sweep.
Sonnu falls from a loading crane and gets up shaking.

reply.summary: Tesrasa is a green-haired, black-eyed dog from a topsy-turvy world who turns into any boy on the planet and borrows his gifts. Tesrasa takes compliments as insults and joins a strange team.

feats.scene: Tesrasa shifts into a muscular teen and flips a vending machine.
Tesrasa is flung into a wall and bounces back barking.

reply.summary: Rosle is a young recruit who dons a suit that makes him light as air and blows a horn with a powerful sonic punch. Rosle perishes fighting minions of a dark power.

feats.scene: Rosle blasts a horn note and shatters a row of windows.
Rosle drifts into a hail of thrown debris and floats clear.

reply.summary: Iasttor is a blond pathfinder from a strange realm who rides giant grasshoppers and flinches from danger. Iasttor guides a hero against hostile warlocks and later may be nothing but a dream.

feats.scene: Iasttor nudges his grasshopper into a hurdle and tips a scout off.
Iasttor tumbles off his mount and scrambles behind a rock.

reply.summary: Riauau is a brown-haired councilman who rises to run a vast metropolis, bought and paid for by a tycoon. Riauau signs whatever contracts his patron slides across the desk.

feats.scene: Riauau slams a gavel and silences a heckling aide.
Riauau stumbles at a podium and recovers his tie.

reply.summary: Nteiu is a dark-haired ex-convict who climbs into a mechanized suit to wreck a bridge for a camera crew. Nteiu is a crook with a sick mother and a strong grudge.

feats.scene: Nteiu rams his armored fists into a bridge support and cracks the span.
Nteiu's suit survives a flying powerhouse's punches until it finally breaks.

reply.summary: Urnnt is a blond security guard and fallen sports hero who grows bitter and drinks too much. Urnnt harasses a woman who left him and gets tossed into a lift.

feats.scene: Urnnt swings a drunken haymaker at a rival in a hotel corridor.
Urnnt is hurled through a doorway into an elevator and lies winded.

reply.summary: Taros is a many-armed, many-faced god of making who sits on a sacred peak and writes each newborn's fate across its brow. Taros is calm, neutral, and permanent, with the patience of the ages.

feats.scene: Taros exhales and a whole world takes shape from drifting dust.
Taros sits unmoved as a rival god's storm tears a mountain range apart around him.

reply.summary: Resronnin is a self-indulgent genius whose mind lives in a metal frame, who once schemed for world rule and now craves a lazy retirement in the sun. Resronnin builds a time device from a stolen sketch.

feats.scene: Resronnin swings a metal arm and flings a thug across a patio.
Resronnin's steel casing survives a heavy fall from a balcony.

reply.summary: Ntinen is a gifted criminal whose thinking organ floats in a metal case with robotic tentacles. Ntinen is dragged into a contest of wits and wheels and loses control of his racer.

feats.scene: Ntinen whips a tentacle and flips a rival's racing cart.
Ntinen's case is shot and spins but holds together.

reply.summary: Rirola is an irritable scientist whose mind is saved in a machine body after a military raid on a research lab. Rirola is rescued by a super-smart ape partner who becomes a lover.

feats.scene: Rirola's robot arm slaps a vial rack aside and catches the last sample.
Rirola's casing survives a fall off a lab bench.

reply.summary: Seolluti is a master criminal who lives as a preserved mind in a metal case and runs a vast weapons trade. Seolluti has an armed ape for a companion and a long grudge against a rival scientist.

feats.scene: Seolluti orders an arms cache detonated and levels a warehouse corner.
Seolluti's case is dropped down a stairwell and the fluid inside sloshes but holds.

reply.summary: Coramrn is a jarred mind that falls into a rigged quiz show and loses to a green-skinned contestant. Coramrn finds himself sliced in half by a strip of tape in a tower squabble.

feats.scene: Coramrn buzzes in first and flips the scoreboard with a flash of lights.
Coramrn's jar rocks on the table but does not crack.

reply.summary: Lecoriu is a burned scholar whose mind survives in a jar after an explosion, sustained by a devoted ape friend. Lecoriu grows paranoid and leads a band of outcasts who strike at a rich tycoon's plant.

feats.scene: Lecoriu directs a raid and an ape friend smashes a security booth.
Lecoriu's jar is jolted by a stun grenade and the fluid ripples but holds.

reply.summary: Amoseor is a motionless mastermind who speaks through a machine and plans a worldwide purge of heroes. Amoseor leans on a huge ape for transport and muscle until a counterattack freezes both.

feats.scene: Amoseor commands a huge ape to hurl a barricade across a corridor.
Amoseor's casing holds together through a rattling siege of the hideout.
